ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

2. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

6. Solve for x: x + 9 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 15
   C. 9
   D. 7

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 49

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

12. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 1

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
